pairs.evidence: features/shared/provenance/provenanceSource.test.ts:14 The guard that is meant to prove caseFileLink holds 'no second person-id regex' only matches the identifier name PERSON_ID, so renaming the constant brings the duplicate regex back and the test stays green.

techniques.evidence: features/shared/provenance/provenanceSource.test.ts:14 Name key: `const PERSON_RE = /…/` keeps the behaviour and clears the check. The verdict does not say that no invariant key exists.

features/shared/provenance/provenanceSource.test.ts:8 The haystack is raw file text and comments are never stripped, so the presence controls (import line, satisfies Record, role=dialog aria-modal) could be met by a comment. The standard requires presence assertions to be normalised to code.

features/shared/provenance/receipt.ts:182 A gated relation with a missing or unknown review_state is shown as pending_review and never as verified, so missing evidence fails closed. receipt.test.ts:89 pins this.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: scripts/data-analysis/promote-verdicts.ts:82 When the slice's rows file is missing, the entity-id membership check that the header promises ('a non-row id is rejected') is skipped without a word, and the verdict is counted as validated anyway.

techniques.evidence: scripts/data-analysis/promote-verdicts.ts:82 Missing evidence turns into a silent skip. It should be a loud, counted could-not-run.

scripts/data-analysis/validate-verdict.ts:27 A --rows file that was asked for but is malformed drops the membership leg, and the script still prints OK and exits 0. A clean exit does not show the requested check ran.
scripts/data-analysis/promote-verdicts.ts:4 Persisted scores come from the deterministic scorer. The subagent's own composite is only compared with that score (line 95) and never trusted.

scripts/data-analysis/kg-forensics.ts:110 When the gate runs with a narrowed scope it names what is missing and a remedy that exists (scripts/data-analysis/esbirka-laws.ts). validate-verdict.ts:48 likewise names 'discard scores and re-run'.

pairs.evidence: features/profile/profileSource.test.ts:14 The guard against the last-segment Number() id read is keyed on the literal variable name otherId and exact spelling, so renaming the variable or reformatting the call brings back the forbidden read with the test green.

techniques.evidence: features/profile/profileSource.test.ts:14 Name/spelling key that the author controls. Line 22 (`toISOString().slice(0, 10)` with exact spacing) has the same shape.

features/profile/profileSource.test.ts:8 Presence controls (lines 13, 21, 25) run over raw text with comments in it, so prose can satisfy them. The standard requires presence assertions normalised to code.

techniques.evidence: lib/analysis/contribution.ts:133 A blanket waiver: two different conflicting refs are both overridden by a flag that names neither. The override message does at least print the refs it replaced.
lib/analysis/contribution.ts:142 The refusal names scripts/data-analysis/kg-contribution-recompute.ts, which exists, and the override.
lib/analysis/contribution.test.ts:241 A seeded foreign-ref node proves that the guard refuses.
lib/analysis/contribution-legacy.test.ts:51 The replay oracle is frozen by a test, not only by the 'DO NOT modernize' prose, so a fix to the live formula cannot move it.
lib/analysis/contribution.ts:123 Unstamped nodes pass, but they are counted and named in the verdict message instead of being folded in silently.
